review.assessment:
This change replaces the unquoted `$@` with quoted `"$@"` to prevent the shell from performing word splitting on arguments containing spaces. It moves the leading-comma logic into an explicit conditional inside the loop, allowing it to drop the `${result#,}` post-processing step since the result string is now constructed without a leading comma. Consequently, each command-line argument is treated as a discrete unit and joined correctly by commas only when multiple arguments are provided.
